svg.text: The Compose version (scenarios/two-party/compose.yaml): the authority, a provider and a consumer, each a portitor-connector and its portitor-identity, and a web server with the provider's
data. Plain HTTP inside one container network; management APIs and the provider's data plane on 127.0.0.1 only. run-local.sh runs the same as processes, without containers.
One machine [Docker, or rootless Podman, with Docker Compose]
